title: Google, Bill Gates's fund invests $31.8M in California startup aiming to build solar farm using robots
summary_full: A California startup has successfully garnered considerable funding to enhance its robotic technology for solar park installations. Planted seeks to redefine the construction industry by creating a repeatable, production-line method. By employing advanced software and robotics, they precisely position solar panel posts, allowing for installations across diverse terrains and maximizing energy productivity per acre. Their groundbreaking approach is set to hasten the adoption of solar energy on a larger scale.
